nameOrigin: icy region around the North Pole

pokedexEntries.rb: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

pokedexEntries.ye: A legendary bird POKéMON. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.

pokedexEntries.go: The magnificent, seemingly translucent wings of this legendary bird POKéMON are said to be made of ice.

pokedexEntries.si: One of the legendary bird POKéMON, it chills moisture in the atmosphere to create snow while flying.

pokedexEntries.cr: Legendary bird POKéMON. As it flies through the sky, it cools the air, causing snow to fall.

pokedexEntries.ru: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this POKéMON flies, snow will fall.
